title: Performance Marketer
description:
Performance Marketing \& Demand Generation
   




* Plan, execute, and optimize paid campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube Ads, and Display Networks.


* Manage and scale monthly marketing budgets from ₹10 Lakhs to ₹1 Crore\+.


* Drive qualified leads, demo bookings, free trial signups, and revenue opportunities.


* Develop and execute full\-funnel demand generation campaigns across multiple geographies.



 Account\-Based Marketing (ABM)
   




* Build and execute ABM campaigns targeting enterprise and mid\-market accounts.


* Create audience segments based on industry, company size, intent signals, and buying stages.


* Work closely with sales teams to align target account strategies.



 Marketing Automation \& Lead Nurturing
   




* Design and implement automated lead nurturing workflows.


* Manage integrations between CRM, marketing automation, and advertising platforms.


* Develop lead scoring models and lifecycle marketing programs.


* Optimize lead handoff processes between marketing and sales.



 Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
   




* Improve landing page conversion rates and user journeys.


* Conduct A/B testing on ads, landing pages, forms, and CTAs.


* Analyze funnel performance and identify drop\-off points.


* Increase visitor\-to\-lead and lead\-to\-customer conversion rates.



 Analytics \& Revenue Attribution
   




* Build dashboards and reports using GA4, GTM, Looker Studio, and CRM platforms.


* Track and report on CPL, CAC, ROAS, Pipeline Contribution, and Revenue Attribution.


* Implement multi\-touch attribution models.


* Provide actionable insights to improve campaign performance and marketing ROI.



 Growth \& Innovation
   




* Identify new acquisition channels and growth opportunities.


* Test emerging platforms, AI tools, and audience targeting strategies.


* Monitor industry trends and competitor activities.


* Collaborate with Product, Sales, and Customer Success teams to improve go\-to\-market performance.


 Requirements
   

  

* 3–8 years of experience in Performance Marketing and Demand Generation.


* Proven experience managing B2B SaaS or Technology marketing campaigns.


* Expertise in Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Microsoft Ads, and Meta Ads.


* Strong knowledge of marketing automation and CRM systems.


* Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4\), Google Tag Manager (GTM), and Looker Studio.


* Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.


* Experience managing high\-value marketing budgets.


* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.



 Preferred Skills
   




* Experience in AI, SaaS, MarTech, SalesTech, CRM, or Lead Generation platforms.


* Hands\-on experience with Zoho CRM, HubSpot, Salesforce, or Marketo.


* Knowledge of ABM platforms such as Demandbase, 6sense, or ZoomInfo.


* Experience with website visitor intelligence and intent data platforms.


* Familiarity with AI\-driven marketing tools and automation technologies.



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   




* Generate 600\+ Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) per month.


* Achieve target Cost Per Lead (CPL) and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC).


* Deliver 175\+ qualified demo bookings per month.


* Generate ₹50 Lakhs\+ marketing\-influenced pipeline monthly.


* Maintain ROAS of 4X or higher.


* Improve landing page conversion rates above industry benchmarks.


* Increase marketing contribution to revenue and ARR growth.

title: GDS Cyber - DPP - Manager - AI Data Protection Engineering
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI Data Protection Forward Deployed Engineer – Manager**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI Data Protection Forward Deployed Engineer – Manager to act as the technical owner for client\-facing data protection transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a hands\-on leader who can move from discovery to design to deployment, embedding closely with clients to architect and implement high\-impact solutions while leading engineering teams and shaping deals. Your internal role matrix positions this level as the next step beyond field/staff engineering: not just delivery, but architecting solutions at the intersection of platforms and AI tools (agents and models). That aligns closely with external FDE market patterns focused on customer\-embedded technical ownership and end\-to\-end production deployment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the discovery, architecture, and deployment of AI\-enabled data protection solutions for strategic clients, translating business, privacy, and cybersecurity requirements into scalable technical designs.
* Serve as a forward deployed technical leader, embedding with client stakeholders to break down ambiguous problem statements, make architecture decisions, and drive measurable outcomes in production. External FDE role definitions from EY, Databricks, Palantir, and Deloitte all emphasize this embedded technical ownership model.
* Architect integrations across data protection platforms, AI models, copilots, RAG pipelines, enterprise data estates, and downstream security/policy controls.
* Lead engineering teams through build, integration, testing, troubleshooting, go\-live, and post\-deployment hardening while maintaining delivery quality, client confidence, and practical execution pace.
* Shape pursuit solutions through demonstrations, solution architecture, proofs of concept, effort estimates, and technical proposals. This is explicitly called out in external FDE manager patterns.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI data protection offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8–12 years of experience across data protection, cybersecurity engineering, security architecture, privacy engineering, cloud security, or related fields.
* Strong depth in data protection, data discovery/classification, PKI \& KMS, and information rights management.
* Strong working knowledge of ML, deep learning, NLP, RAG, AI\-assisted prioritization, and model risk scoring, with experience applying these to enterprise problem\-solving.
* Demonstrated experience designing and deploying enterprise\-grade solutions across cloud and hybrid environments, ideally on Azure, AWS, or GCP. Comparable FDE manager roles consistently require cloud\-native delivery, APIs, and production systems ownership.
* Hands\-on experience with AI/data protection tooling such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Claude Enterprise, Gemini Enterprise, Purview, DSPM platforms, Python, and related enterprise engineering tools.
* Strong client\-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in a professional services, solutions engineering, field engineering, or forward deployed model.
* Familiarity with regulated sectors such as financial services, healthcare, public sector, or large multinational enterprises. External senior digital trust/privacy FDE roles explicitly value regulated\-industry depth.
* Experience with pricing inputs, solution estimation, and technical deal shaping.


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of data protection, privacy, cloud, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the data protection practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.
   

  

**Typical work environment**
* Global, cross\-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery

title: Academic Advisor
description:
**Company Description** 
 SPM Study Abroad specializes in guiding students who aspire to pursue higher education across global destinations. The organization provides expert counseling and personalized support to help students identify universities, courses, and countries that match their academic interests and career plans. With a strong emphasis on transparency and clear guidance, SPM Study Abroad supports students throughout the entire process, from applications to visas. The team is dedicated to empowering students to access international opportunities and build successful futures, reflecting the core belief that each student’s journey is the company’s mission.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Academic Advisor role at SPM Study Abroad is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Coimbatore. The Academic Advisor will meet and counsel students and families, understand academic backgrounds and career ambitions, and recommend suitable courses, universities, and study destinations. Daily tasks include conducting one\-on\-one advising sessions, explaining admission and scholarship requirements, guiding students through application and documentation processes, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure smooth progress. The role also involves supporting students with standardized test requirements, timelines, and visa procedures, maintaining accurate advising records, and participating in information sessions, seminars, and outreach activities. The Academic Advisor is expected to provide clear, unbiased guidance while maintaining a student\-centered, professional, and ethical approach.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Student Counseling and Academic Advising skills to guide learners through program and institution selection.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills, including the ability to explain complex processes clearly and build trust with students and families.
* Candidates should possess Career Counseling skills to help students align academic choices with long\-term professional goals.
* Candidates should possess a solid understanding of Education systems and international higher education pathways.
* Bachelor’s degree in Education, Counseling, Psychology, Management, or a related field; relevant postgraduate qualifications are an advantage.
* Prior experience in academic advising, study abroad consulting, or student services is highly beneficial.
* Ability to work with diverse student backgrounds, demonstrate cultural sensitivity, and maintain confidentiality and ethical standards.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and proficiency with basic office software and online communication tools.

title: Quality Control Inspector
description:
Responsible for ensuring the quality of sheet metal fabricated and welded components by monitoring production processes, conducting inspections, identifying defects, and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Conduct incoming, in\-process, and final inspection of sheet metal and welded components.
* Inspect components manufactured through Laser Cutting, CNC Bending, Fabrication, TIG Welding and MIG Welding processes.
* Verify component dimensions using Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Height Gauge, Gauges and other measuring instruments.
* Check welding quality, including weld size, penetration, bead appearance, undercut, porosity, cracks, spatter and distortion.
* Ensure welding operations are carried out as per WPS, drawings, specifications and quality standards.
* Interpret and understand engineering drawings, GD\&T and welding symbols.
* Prepare and maintain Inspection Reports, Quality Check Sheets, NCR Reports and other quality records.
* Identify process and product defects and coordinate with Production and Engineering teams for corrective actions.
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) using tools such as 5 Why, Fishbone Analysis and 8D.
* Implement and monitor Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
* Monitor welding and fabrication process parameters and ensure compliance with approved standards.
* Support first\-piece inspection, prototype inspection and new product development activities.
* Conduct welding defect analysis and support improvement activities to reduce rejection and rework.
* Ensure calibration status of measuring instruments and maintain relevant records.
* Participate in internal, customer and certification audits.
* Support implementation of 5S, Kaizen, Continuous Improvement and Zero Defect initiatives.
* Coordinate with Production, PPC, Maintenance and Engineering teams to resolve quality issues.
* Prepare daily/weekly quality reports covering rejection, rework, defects and process performance.
* Ensure compliance with applicable QMS procedures and customer\-specific requirements.


**Required Skills**
* Good knowledge of Sheet Metal Fabrication and Welding Processes.
* Strong knowledge of TIG and MIG Welding and common welding defects.
* Ability to read and interpret 2D engineering drawings and welding symbols.
* Knowledge of GD\&T and dimensional inspection.
* Knowledge of measuring instruments and inspection methods.
* Knowledge of RCA, CAPA, 8D and problem\-solving techniques.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Basic knowledge of ISO 9001 Quality Management System.
* MS Office knowledge, particularly Excel and Word.


**Qualification**
* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or equivalent.


**Experience**
* 1–2 years of experience in Quality Engineering in sheet metal fabrication, TIG/MIG welding or automotive/engineering manufacturing


 .
 **Preferred Experience** 
* Experience in Laser Cutting, CNC Bending, Welding \& Fabricatio
* n.Experience handling customer complaints and NCR/CAP
* A.Knowledge of welding quality standards and inspection practice
* s.Experience in CMM or other advanced inspection equipment will be an added advantag

title: Quality Engineer – Incoming Inspection
description:
Company Overview:
   

  

 If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Here, your opportunity for professional development and industry leading rewards will be supported by our foundational commitments to the values of people first, integrity and safety. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone!
   

  

**Role Summary:**
 The Incoming Quality Control (IQC) Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all incoming materials, components, and products meet quality requirements, customer specifications, and applicable standards. The role involves incoming inspection, supplier quality management, documentation review, problem\-solving, and continuous improvement activities to support manufacturing and assembly operations.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Inspect incoming materials and components for physical defects, dimensional accuracy, and compliance with drawings, specifications, and quality standards.
* Verify that incoming materials meet the required quantity and quality requirements.

* Proven experience managing high\-impact, enterprise\-wide incidents in complex, multi\-cloud or hybrid IT environments.

title: Clinical Audiologist
description:
**Company Description** 
 Global Hearing Aid Centre is a consumer services company specializing in hearing care solutions, currently operating in Tamil Nadu, India. The organization focuses on providing diagnostic hearing services and hearing aid fittings for individuals with hearing and communication challenges. Team members work closely with clients to improve overall hearing health and quality of life through personalized care. The company values professionalism, ethical practice, and a client\-centered approach in all services offered.
 



**Role Description** 
 This full\-time on\-site Clinical Audiologist role is based in Chennai and involves providing comprehensive audiological services to clients of varied ages. Daily responsibilities include conducting hearing assessments, interpreting test results, and recommending appropriate treatment plans and hearing solutions. The Clinical Audiologist will perform hearing aid selection, fitting, programming, and follow\-up care, while maintaining accurate clinical records and documentation. The role also includes aural rehabilitation services, counseling clients and families on hearing health, and collaborating with other professionals to support speech and communication outcomes. The clinician is expected to follow evidence\-based practices, uphold regulatory standards, and contribute to continuous improvement of clinic processes and patient experience.
 



**Qualifications** 




  




* Strong clinical skills in Audiology and Hearing Aid Dispensing, including audiometric testing, hearing aid fitting, verification, and counseling.
* Experience in Speech and Speech Therapy to support communication development, including collaboration with speech\-language professionals when needed.
* Proficiency in Aural Rehabilitation, including auditory training, communication strategies, and patient education.
* Recognized degree in Audiology and Hearing (e.g., BASLP, MASLP, MSc Audiology or equivalent) from an accredited institution.
* Relevant professional registration or license as required by local regulations.
* Ability to communicate clearly and empathetically with clients and families, with strong documentation and organizational skills.
* Comfort working in an on\-site clinical setting, with the ability to manage a steady caseload and work as part of a multidisciplinary team.
* Prior experience in a hearing care clinic or hospital setting is an advantage.

title: AR Caller - RCM Healthcare
description:
**Company Description** 
 Wave Online LLC is a leading provider of Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and Health Information Management (HIMS) solutions for a wide range of healthcare providers, including medical billing companies, hospitals, faculty practices, ambulatory surgery centers, long\-term care facilities, and pharmacies. Since 1999, the company has focused on delivering high\-quality patient care documentation across multi\-specialty practices throughout the United States. * Candidates should possess computer proficiency, including working with billing software, CRM or practice management systems, and basic MS Office applications.
* Candidates should possess organizational and time\-management capabilities to handle multiple accounts, meet daily call and follow\-up targets, and maintain accurate records.

description:

 Cotiviti is a leading analytics\-driven organization focused on improving the financial and quality performance of its clients across healthcare and retail. title: Senior Meta Ads Manager
description:
Concept Marketing is a Perth\-based digital marketing agency with 25\+ years of experience working across a broad range of Australian and international clients. We are looking for a Senior Paid Social Manager to join our offshore team, working closely with our Australian head office to plan, build, manage, and report on Meta advertising campaigns across the full client portfolio.
 



  





 This is a senior, hands\-on role. You will own Meta delivery from strategy through to execution. You will be expected to work independently, communicate clearly, diagnose problems across the full funnel, and apply instructions without needing them repeated.
 



  





 What You Will Do
 



 Campaign Strategy and Architecture
 


* Build, launch, and optimise Meta ad campaigns across Facebook and Instagram for multiple clients simultaneously
* Structure campaigns correctly from the ground up, including objectives, ad sets, audiences, placements, budgets, and bidding strategies
* Know when to consolidate campaigns versus segment them, and understand how Meta's auction and delivery system responds to structural decisions
* Use campaign budget optimisation versus ad set budget optimisation strategically, not by default
* Manage ad fatigue cycles and rotate creative proactively before performance drops
* Manage frequency intentionally across funnel stages
* Run all campaign types including lead generation, conversion, awareness, retargeting, and traffic



  





**Audience and Signal Strategy** 



* Build and maintain a clean, organised custom audience library across all client accounts
* Develop full\-funnel audience strategy including custom audiences, lookalikes, retargeting segments, and exclusion logic
* Understand audience overlap and apply exclusion logic correctly
* Use value\-based lookalikes where purchase or lead quality data exists
* Know when broad targeting with strong creative outperforms narrow audience targeting, and test accordingly
* Understand Advantage\+ audiences and when to use or constrain them



  





**Tracking, Technical Setup, and Data Integrity** 



* Implement and verify the Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and custom events
* Configure Aggregated Event Measurement correctly post\-iOS 14
* Set up GA4 goals and conversion tracking and connect these to campaign reporting
* Maintain accurate and consistent UTM structures across all campaigns
* Troubleshoot tracking issues independently before escalating
* Understand the differences between Meta\-reported data, GA4 data, and actual CRM or backend conversions, and be able to explain the gap clearly
* Set up and interpret Meta Attribution Settings correctly based on business type and sales cycle
* Know the limitations of iOS 14\+ signal loss and apply practical responses including first\-party data strategy
* Identify when data is unreliable and flag it rather than report it as fact



  





**Ad Creative** 



* Brief designers and copywriters with enough specificity that the output is usable without rework
* Write ad copy that is direct, on\-brand, and built to convert
* Read creative performance data and identify whether an issue is the hook, the body, the CTA, the format, or the audience mismatch
* Understand the difference between a scroll\-stop problem and a conversion problem
* Structure creative testing with a clear hypothesis, not random variation
* Review creative performance and feed learnings back into briefing



  





**Problem Solving and Diagnosis** 



* Diagnose performance issues across the full funnel, from impression through to conversion, before escalating or reporting a problem
* Review landing pages before campaigns go live and flag conversion issues proactively
* Understand that a low conversion rate is not always a media problem and communicate clearly to the relevant team what needs to change and why
* Read client performance in the context of the business, not just the platform
* Factor in seasonality, sales cycles, and external variables when interpreting results
* Do not over\-claim credit for results or under\-explain causes of decline
* Surface issues early with context and a recommended next step, not just a notification that something is wrong



  





**Reporting** 



* Prepare clear, accurate performance reports for the Australian team on a regular cadence
* Report against agreed KPIs including cost per lead, ROAS, CTR, conversion rate, and spend efficiency
* Present data with interpretation, not just numbers
* Flag anomalies and performance shifts proactively, not reactively



  





**Staying Current** 



* Keep up with Meta platform changes, new ad formats, and algorithm updates as they happen
* Test new features including Advantage\+, Advantage\+ creative, and AI\-driven tools with intent, not just because they are available
* Understand where Meta's automated tools perform well and where they need to be constrained or overridden



  





**Account Hygiene and Documentation** 



* Maintain clear naming conventions, account notes, and change logs so anyone can pick up an account and understand its history
* Document what has been tested, what worked, and what was ruled out
* Treat account hygiene as a non\-negotiable, not an optional extra



  





**Organic and Scheduled Social (Desirable)** 



* Support content scheduling and organic planning using tools such as Sked Social or equivalent
* Coordinate scheduling of content across client accounts in line with approved content calendars



  





**Communication and Collaboration** 



* Work directly with the Australian team via scheduled check\-ins and async communication
* Follow briefs and documented instructions accurately without requiring clarification on previously covered ground
* Ask the right questions upfront and then execute without hand\-holding
* Communicate issues early and clearly, with context and a recommended course of action



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Minimum 10\+ years of hands\-on Meta Ads experience managing multiple accounts simultaneously
* Strong technical knowledge of Ads Manager, Business Manager, Meta Events Manager, and Conversions API
* Solid understanding of GA4, conversion tracking, attribution, and UTM structure
* Experience with full\-funnel campaign strategy, audience architecture, and creative testing frameworks
* Ability to diagnose performance problems across media, creative, tracking, and landing page without being directed to do so
* Excellent written English communication skills
* High attention to detail across naming conventions, tracking, budgets, and reporting
* Proven ability to work independently within a remote team structure
* Experience working with or reporting to teams in a different time zone, ideally Australia



  





**Desirable** 



* Experience using Sked Social or a comparable scheduling platform
* Organic social content planning experience
* Agency environment experience managing multiple client accounts



  





**What We Expect From You** 




**This role requires someone who can read a brief, understand the objective, and execute correctly the first time. We document our processes, and we expect them to be followed. We give feedback once, and we expect it to be applied. If something is unclear, we expect you to ask before you start, not after you have finished.** 




**When something is not working, we expect you to investigate, form a view, and bring a recommendation. We do not expect perfection, but we do expect ownership. We are not looking for someone to be managed. We are looking for someone who manages their own work to a high standard, communicates when it matters, and makes the Australian team's job easier, not harder.** 




  





**Reporting Structure \& Team Interaction** 




**You will report to the Head of Digital Services. This is primarily a non\-client\-facing role, requiring close collaboration with the Digital \& Marketing Team in Perth and the digital and web team based in Coimbatore.** 




**Weekly Meetings and briefing sessions will be conducted, along with workflow and task updates through Monday.com. Training on Monday.com will be provided for seamless team integration.** 




  





**Work Location:** 




**This is a full\-time role (Monday–Friday) based in our Coimbatore office. As we collaborate closely with our Perth team, your working hours will be 7:30 AM – 4:00 PM IST to align with their schedule.** 




  





**To Apply** 




**Please submit your CV along with a summary covering:** 



* The Meta accounts you have managed and approximate monthly spend levels
* The types of campaigns you have run and the objectives they were built against
* Any tracking or technical setup work you have handled directly
* An example of a performance problem you identified and how you resolved it

description:

 Waveonline LLC is a leading provider of Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and Health Information Management (HIMS) solutions for healthcare providers and pharmacies across the United States. The company supports medical billing organizations, hospitals, faculty practices, ambulatory surgery centers, and long\-term care facilities with comprehensive end\-to\-end RCM services. * Experience handling insurance calls (commercial, government payers), claim status verification, and resolution of denials or rejections.
* Proficiency with medical billing software, practice management systems, and basic MS Office tools (Excel, Word).

1. A portfolio of three content pieces they consider their best work, with one line on the measurable outcome of each (ranking, citation, conversion, etc.).
2. (Optional but preferred) One example of a query where AI search engines currently give an inaccurate answer about our product category, along with a brief explanation of how they would correct it.

title: Consultant / Scientist: Molecular and Diagnostic Microbiology
description:
**P. Namperumalsamy Regional Research Center (PNRRC), Aravind Eye Hospital, Coimbatore** 




  




* **Qualification: MD (Microbiology) or PhD (Microbiology).**
* **Experience: Hands\-on experience in a diagnostic microbiology laboratory is essential. Appointment: Full\-time.**
* **Designation (Consultant or Scientist) will depend on qualification and experience**
* **Salary: Commensurate with qualification and experience**



  





**The role** 



* Aravind Eye Hospital, Coimbatore, is looking for a microbiologist to lead its Molecular and Diagnostic Microbiology program at PNRRC. The position carries full responsibility for the diagnostic microbiology laboratory and for the molecular diagnostics research program.



**Diagnostic service** 



* Run the diagnostic microbiology laboratory serving a high\-volume tertiary eye hospital: microbial keratitis, endophthalmitis and ocular surface infections
* Maintain quality standards, standard operating procedures and turnaround times, and lead the laboratory towards accreditation
* Work closely with the cornea, retina and other clinical teams on result interpretation and difficult cases



**Molecular diagnostics** 



* Lead the molecular diagnostics program, which currently includes CRISPR/Cas12a\-based rapid pan\-fungal detection, PCR\-based pathogen identification and metagenomic sequencing on an in\-house Nanopore platform
* Take assays from development through optimization, analytical validation and clinical validation, and into routine use where warranted
* Contribute to the design and conduct of the ICMR\-funded multicentre program on molecular diagnosis of fungal endophthalmitis, and related work on infectious keratitis



**Research and training** 



* Design, conduct and publish studies drawing on the hospital's large clinical specimen base
* Contribute to grant applications and external collaborations
* Supervise technical staff and postgraduate trainees



**Essential** 



* MD (Microbiology) or PhD (Microbiology)
* Experience running, or working at a senior level in, a routine diagnostic microbiology laboratory
* Working knowledge of laboratory quality systems
* Ability to function as part of a clinical service and communicate with clinicians
* Demonstrated interest in research (publications, projects or grants)



**Desirable** 



* Molecular diagnostic assay development and validation
* PCR, sequencing (including Nanopore metagenomics)



**What Aravind offers** 



* A high\-volume tertiary eye hospital: the laboratory receives approximately 1000 ocular specimens a year
* An established molecular laboratory with real\-time PCR, a Nanopore sequencer, etc. and a team of 6 technical staff
* An ICMR\-funded multicentre program in molecular diagnostics for endophthalmitis, with assay validation and metagenomic sequencing under way
* Daily working contact between clinicians and researchers, and a research group with a record of publication in ocular infection and molecular diagnostics
* Support for research proposals, conference presentation and postgraduate supervision
* How to apply
* Send the following to siddharth@aravind.org with the subject line "Application: Molecular and Diagnostic Microbiology":
* Curriculum vitae, including a list of publications
* A one\-page statement of research interests and relevant diagnostic laboratory experience
* Names and contact details of two referees

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 5–7 years of relevant manufacturing experience, including experience supervising shop\-floor operations.
* Demonstrated experience in fabrication shop operations and final packaging activities.
* Working knowledge of CNC programming and machining/manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and continuous\-improvement tools, including AMEF/FMEA, VSM, 5S/6S, SMED, and root\-cause analysis.
* Experience with production planning, capacity management, work\-center scheduling, and inventory/WIP management.
* Strong understanding of quality systems, process control, and ISO 9001/ISO 14001 requirements.
* Familiarity with API 610, ASME standards, and preferably AWS welding standards.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, work instructions, and manufacturing procedures.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office applications, ERP systems, and Microsoft Project or comparable scheduling software.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem\-solving, and team\-development skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in pump manufacturing, including API and non\-API pump production processes.
* Experience implementing Lean, Operational Excellence, or continuous\-improvement initiatives in a manufacturing environment.
* Exposure to statistical process control, quality tools, and structured corrective\-action methodologies.
* Knowledge of welding, fabrication, assembly, testing, and packaging processes for industrial equipment.

 Own the store’s P\&L and customer experience. Drive sales, manage inventory and costs, lead the store team, and ensure Kitser’s brand standards in merchandising, service, and operations. 
 



  
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 1\. Sales \& Business Growth
 



 Achieve monthly sales, margin, and Category targets for Retail Division
 



 Plan and execute store\-level promotions, festive offers, and local marketing activations with the marketing team. 
 



 Monitor daily/weekly sales dashboards; take corrective actions on slow categories and SKUs. 
 



 Track key retail KPIs: conversion rate, average transaction value (ATV), items per customer (IPC), and footfall\-to\-sale. 
 



 2\. Customer Experience
 



 • Ensure a high\-quality in\-store experience: greeting, needs assessment, product demos, and post\-sale follow\-up. 
 



 • Resolve complaints and escalations quickly; maintain high CSAT/NPS. 
 



 3\. Inventory \& Stock Management
 



 • Maintain optimal stock levels across categories; minimize stockouts and overstock. 
 



 • Ensure accurate inventory records, cycle counts, and shrinkage control (theft/damage/errors). 
 



 • Coordinate with vendors/warehouses and Category Managers for timely replenishment and new launches. 
 



 4\. Visual Merchandising \& Store Standards
 



 • Implement brand\-compliant displays, signage, and product placement; keep the store clean and presentable. 
 



 • Execute seasonal/festive decor and POSM as per marketing calendars. 
 



 • Ensure safety, security, and compliance with store SOPs and local regulations. 
 



 5\. Team Leadership \& HR
 



 • Hire, train, schedule, and supervise sales associates, and support staff. 
 



 • Conduct performance reviews, coaching, and incentive tracking against KPIs. 
 



 • Maintain attendance, leave, and discipline records; create a positive, high\-performance culture. 
 



 6\. Operations, Finance \& Reporting
 



 • Manage daily cash/POS reconciliation and cash transfers as per finance policy. 
 



 • Control operating expenses (staffing, utilities, supplies) to protect store profitability. 
 



 • Prepare and submit weekly/monthly reports: sales vs target, inventory, shrinkage, expenses, and action plans. 
 



  
 



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 



 • Sales achievement (% to target), gross margin %, and category mix. 
 



 • Conversion rate, ATV, IPC, and footfall utilization. 
 



 • Inventory accuracy and shrinkage rate. 
 



 • Customer satisfaction/complaint resolution time. 
 



 • Staff productivity, attendance, and training completion. 
 



 • Cost control vs budget (OPEX). 
 



  
 



 Qualifications \& Experience
 



 • Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PG in Retail/Operations is a plus. 
 



 • 8 \-10 years of retail/store management experience; consumer durables, or home improvement preferred. 
 



 • Strong hands\-on experience with POS systems, Excel/Google Sheets, and basic reporting. 
 



  
 



 Skills \& Competencies
 



 • Sales leadership, negotiation, and customer handling. 
 



 • Inventory and vendor coordination. 
 



 • Visual merchandising sense and brand compliance. 
 



 • People management, coaching, and conflict resolution. 
 



 • Data\-driven decision\-making and problem\-solving. 
 



  
 



 Working Conditions
 



 • Full\-time role with rotating shifts/week off as per retail roster. 
 


* • Frequent floor time; occasional travel for training/vendor meetings.

title: FS - RC - Actuarial - IFRS17- Life- Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Role Name And Description**
**Staff, P\&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
 Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high\-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a Staff member to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
   

  

 Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on\-the\-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
   

  

 Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 As a Staff member within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
   

  

 On engagements, you will:
   

  

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Seniors, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members


 Within the actuarial practice you will:
   

  

* Estimate actuarial liability for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR model using the data supplied for estimation
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Updating the report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS or similar reserving software is desirable, but not mandatory
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as SQL and Alteryx is an added advantage
* Familiarity with IFRS 17 and Solvency II frameworks is preferred
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise


 We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
   

  

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
   

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 1\+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi\-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Proficiency in MS\-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx etc, will be a plus
* Good exam progress


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)


**What We Look For**
* Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting.
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**

**Role Summary**

The role is responsible for assessing database recovery readiness, validating disaster recovery capabilities, strengthening cyber recovery preparedness, and driving database resilience improvements through structured assessments, testing, remediation planning, and stakeholder engagement.

* Plan and execute database DR tests, cyber recovery simulations, failover/failback exercises, and evidence\-based recovery validation activities.
* Assess database backup and recovery architectures for immutability, replication, retention, air\-gap/vaulting controls, RPO/RTO alignment, and restoration readiness.
* Develop cyber recovery playbooks for ransomware and destructive cyber scenarios, including clean\-room recovery, trusted restore points, and database integrity validation.
* Identify resilience gaps, SPOFs, recovery risks, and operational weaknesses, and translate findings into remediation roadmaps and executive reporting.
* Collaborate with cyber security, infrastructure, cloud, application, audit, and business teams to align database recovery capabilities with business priorities.

* Strong database administration experience across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and cloud database platforms.

* Familiarity with supporting infrastructure components including storage, virtualization, networking, identity services, and cloud platforms.
* Practical DR knowledge covering failover/failback, workload recovery, recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, validation, and improvement planning.
* Cyber recovery understanding covering ransomware impacts, clean recovery, database integrity validation, identity recovery, Zero Trust principles, and trusted restore capabilities.
* Strong consulting, stakeholder management, technical documentation, delivery quality, and leadership communication skills.
* Good understanding of on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid hosting models, data center strategies, and database deployment architectures.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Exposure to AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, AIOps, observability, and telemetry\-driven solutions supporting runbook generation, dependency analysis, recovery workflow automation, and resilience reporting.
* Familiarity with enterprise backup platforms, storage technologies, and infrastructure resilience concepts supporting database recovery.


**Preferred Qualifications And Certifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or a related discipline.
* Desirable certifications include one or more of the following: Oracle DBA, Microsoft Azure Database Administrator, AWS Database Specialty, Azure Solutions Architect
* Experience in technology transformation, regulated environments, or large\-scale database resilience and recovery programs.


**Preferred Profile Attributes**
* Ability to independently lead workstreams, manage senior stakeholders, and mentor delivery teams.
* Comfortable working across database, infrastructure, cloud, cyber security, risk, audit, operations, and business teams.
* Outcome\-focused mindset with emphasis on actionable recommendations, recovery assurance, and measurable resilience improvements.
